note: Two LayoutSpecs for the Home tab, deliberately wrapped under `specs` rather than written as two top-level spec files. `LayoutSpecTests` sweeps every .json in the UI test bundle and asserts it, and until Phase 3e routes the `home` screen id to `FeatureHome.HomeView` the app still renders `PlaceholderScreen` there — a top-level spec would fail the sweep for a reason that has nothing to do with layout. Wrapped, `LayoutSpec.loadAll` skips it (its `try?` decode fails) and `HomeTests` reads it here instead, skipping when Home is not wired. When 3e lands, split this into `home-top.json` and `home-scrolled.json` at the top level and delete the wrapper; the frames need no change.
frameSource: Measured off Reference/home-dark.png (1179x2556 px for 393x852 pt, so pt = px/3) by scanning rows for runs of the card colour #1E1E23, and off the phone-frame window of Reference/onboarding-slide4-search.png (x 256..920, y 754..2170 px) for the two cards above the fold. The tolerance is wider than the Phase 1 tabbar spec because the light numbers carry the mockup's ~2 % vertical stretch. `home.todaysReading` is the exception: 184 pt is the card with an active plan, which is what the reference capture shows, but `--screenshot home` on a clean install has no plan started and draws the 153 pt 'Pick a plan to begin' empty state. 153 is what the route actually renders; seeding fixture user state so a capture shows the reference's active plan belongs with the Phase 4b snapshot sweep.
